useCase: 识别克隆区域、纹理复制和物体移除掩盖
mechanism: 提取 local 特征 descriptors using SIFT or SURF algorithms, then performs nearest-neighbor matching 以识别 duplicate regions. RANSAC filters geometric 不一致 to confirm true copy-move forgeries.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 80-90% for copy-move forgeries with minimal post-processing
name: 复制-移动检测
parameters: Feature detector: SIFT, Match 阈值: 0.75 (Lowe's ratio), Min matches: 10, RANSAC reproj 阈值: 5.0
description: 检测 duplicated regions 内的 an image using keypoint matching. AI tools sometimes replicate texture patches, creating detectable copy-move 模式.

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2011). A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection. IEEE TIFS.
Christlein, V. et al. (2012). An Evaluation of Popular Copy-Move Forgery Detection Approaches. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Excellent for detecting cloned regions
• RANSAC filtering reduces 误报
• Can detect scaled/rotated copies
• Well-proven 取证 technique
limitations:
• Only 检测 duplication 内的 single image
• Heavy post-processing can mask copied regions
• 计算成本高 for large images
• May miss very small duplicated areas
